Medieval Dynasty receives new content with the release of the free Plant a Tree update. This long-requested update brings two major features: the ability to plant trees, using seedlings gathered while chopping wood, and the option to move freely various constructions with your hammer’s new Move Mode. You also get the improved audio, new UI sounds, and various fixes and updates that enhance the overall experience.
For the detailed list of what changes, see the changelog below.

Alongside the update, we’re excited to introduce the very first DLC for Medieval Dynasty – Echoes of Nature. If you’re looking to add more charm and detail to your world, this DLC lets you create beautiful gardens and decorate the alleys and front yards of buildings throughout your village.

It adds a wide variety of new outdoor decorations, including trees, shrubs, hedges, stone elements, and more — all designed to blend naturally with your surroundings and respond to the changing seasons. It’s the perfect way to bring more life and beauty to your settlement.

It features 39 tracks, equalling over 2 hours of immersive music across 3 themed albums:
Disc 1 – Three Bards Album: Six cheerful, festive songs performed by the band Three Bards, inspired by troubadour music
Disc 2 – Special Themes Album: 16 tracks that build the game world’s atmosphere – from the main theme to the character creator music, as well as themes for villages and important NPCs
Disc 3 – Gameplay Music Album: 17 compositions created for exploration and combat
The soundtrack is available for PC platforms (Steam, Epic, GOG), but you can listen to it also using streaming services like Spotify or Apple Music!

On top of all that, we’re also updating the Digital Supporter Pack with some fun and fresh content. You’ll get access to a new game save file, perfect for co-op adventures. Additionally, we’ve added a set of beautiful new wallpapers showing the stunning natural landscapes of the game. Perfect for the summer season.

items.text: Only one week left to the release of all the new content we’ve been preparing for you for the past months. We’ve already shared details on what you can expect from Medieval Dynasty Original Soundtrack Vol. 2 and Echoes of Nature DLC, so now the time has come to bring you closer to the free Plant a Tree update.
We are happy to announce that the update will enable 2 features, which have been requested very frequently.
You will be able to get the tree seedlings while cutting trees. You can plant them, and they will grow into full trees after 4 seasons. They can be cut and will regrow from stumps after 8 seasons.

Possibility to move structures: If you’ve changed the plans for your settlement, you can freely change the building position. Take your hammer, use Move Mode and choose a new place for it. It also allows moving furniture, gates and platforms.
The update will also include a set of other new features, such as:
Intel® XeSS 2 support
New version of the music themes of the villages
New sounds improving immersion
New UI sounds
Chat commands
Apart from adding new options, we also worked on the occurring problems to provide fixes regarding issues with the co-op mode, UI, quests, combat and more. Some of them are:
Crafting many items at once (with the Fast Crafting option) caused all crafted items to have the same condition
Arrows spawned through POIs or by dropping from the inventory despawned on season change
Player bartering skill did not affect prices for horses
Client playing on gamepad couldn’t place platforms
Some items and containers spawned under map in camps
Host didn’t see modules of a building if a client wanted to upgrade it but decided not to
As always, we updated some aspects of the game to respond to the changes introduced by the update, improve the balance and enhance the overall experience. The updates include:
Vendors selling seedlings
New Knowledge Tab entries
Descriptions of the houses
Emote wheel commands
Changes in recipes
The update along with both DLCs will be released on June 26. We are excited to hear what you think about it and we eagerly wait to see how you will use the new features.
Stay tuned for more information.
Kind regards
Render Cube and Toplitz teams

notes.title: What's coming with the Crossplay Update?

items.text: The release date of the Crossplay Update is slowly approaching, so it is time to share what you can expect. The list below presents all the new features that will be introduced for players across all platforms.
Cinematic intro showing how player characters ended up in the Oxbow (those who are already playing will be able to see it on our YouTube channel),
Continuation of the storyline affecting the future of the Oxbow,
Encounters with NPCs scattered around the map,
Ability to build modular bridges and platforms,
A new item - Hand Lantern (to be crafted in the Workshop),
Three Bards visiting taverns on both maps and playing new songs which are also available on our YouTube channel,
Two new emotes (and a better-sorted emote wheel),
Visual improvements to villages on the old map (the Valley),
Improved production planning system (allowing to plan production for specific seasons),
Balance changes, bug fixes, optimisation, and minor improvements.
We are very excited for the upcoming update, and we can’t wait to see and hear your impressions. Stay tuned for more announcements regarding the Crossplay Update!
Kind regards
Render Cube and Toplitz teams

notes.title: What is going on with the update?

items.text: We are asked this question daily in emails, direct messages, and comments, so we want to answer you all in this post.
The update is coming, and it is coming soon.

We work hard every day to provide enjoyable gameplay for players across every platform. It makes us sad to hear that some of our players feel abandoned or forgotten. Our primary concern for the past few months has been to prepare the update for console players, and not only them.

We understand the frustration, as we are equally excited about the release as our community is, but we also acknowledge that the lack of official communication from our side has caused more doubt around the update, and we want to apologise for that.

Very soon we will reveal more specific information about the update which not only will bring awaited co-op mode for consoles but also many surprises for the rest of our amazing players. We are working on the next step marked on our roadmap and we are looking forward to moving further to the new content which will enrich the gameplay.
Kind regards,
Render Cube Team

items.text: We are only a month away from the opening of the Oxbow gates. The residents are cleaning their huts, animals are sharpening their claws, and bandits are polishing their weapons in preparation for your arrival.

To ease the anticipation, we made a new video with some of the features that will be added in the new, free update. Aneta and Marcin share details about the character creator, village management and the emotes system. Have a look!
The Oxbow launches on Steam on December 7th, 2023. The version for the PS5, Xbox Series X/S and other PC platforms will be released in Q1/Q2 of 2024. See you in the Oxbow!
Regards,
Render Cube Team and Toplitz Productions

New is the photo mode!

items.text: Hello Village Elders!
The time has come! You hold in your hands: the Heir Update.
Remember in the game? You have a house; you look at it and then ask if you could still extend it.
We felt the same way, so we took the tools in our hands. We figuratively sawed, filed, sanded and, hammered - and the game got bigger and bigger.

Before the Heir update, Medieval Dynasty had about 75,000 words of text. That's roughly the equivalent of a 250-page book. Now we're close to 120,000 words of text. It took a while to manoeuvre this huge update into the valley, but it's finally here!
Let us know what you think about the update! Tell us about your heir! As always, feel free to post below in the comments or on our social media channels.
Have fun playing and talk soon!
The teams of Render Cube and Toplitz Productions

items.text: Dear Elders!

Gather and behold the latest acquisition to the valley! A few resourceful heads from faraway places have stopped at the tavern and told the villagers about a machine that turns grain into flour by using the power of the wind.
So now it's up to you to put their plans into action and build a miracle of modern medieval technology in the valley.

From big things to smaller things: We have repeatedly read about the great desire to be able to further embellish and decorate your own domicile. We want to help you achieve this dream and have created a few new accessories. Your homes in Medieval Dynasty will also be given new shutters and curtains for windows, shelves, vases and much more.
Nothing stands in the path of upgrading your settlement from beautiful to magnificent.
Speaking of upgrades: The game engine has also been upgraded. From now on, the UE 4.27.2 powers Medieval Dynasty on your PC.
This update is complemented by several bug fixes and improvements.

Tell us in the comments if you like the windmill, where you built it or if you want to challenge it 😊. Of course, feel free to comment on the other features as well! Don't forget to check out our social media channels!
Stay safe and see you around
Render Cube and Toplitz Productions

items.text: Some of you probably have not done this before, so we have a small guide:
You must have Medieval Dynasty in your library – obviously.
The procedure
Open your game library.
Right Click on Medieval Dynasty there.
Open properties.
Select the tab "BETAS".*
Enter this password below the dropdown in the field: MedievalStaging
Press CHECK CODE
Use the drop down and select “release_build_staging”. This is the public stage.
Press Close
Steam should now download this version of the game.
IMPORTANT! PLEASE SAVE YOUR LIVE VERSION SAVES GAME BEFORE ACCESSING THE PUBLIC STAGING BUILD!
Just in case something goes awry!
AppData > Local > Medieval_Dynasty > Saved > SaveGames
*Steam labels all those builds as "betas” albeit they’re not betas, so do not be too confused!
